review_evidence: Reviewed all 28 primary Lean files. The repository develops coinductive constructions, interaction trees/effects and HeapLang-related semantics with theorem-bearing modules.
Coinductive.lean, HeapLang.lean, ITree.lean and ITree/Effects.lean are compact import/navigation surfaces for retained formal modules rather than disposable build/report tooling.
summary: Reviewed coinductive and retained its complete formal-semantics library and navigation roots.

review_evidence: Coinductive.lean, HeapLang.lean, ITree.lean, ITree/Effects.lean: read fully; each holds only an SPDX comment, `module`, and `public import` lines; retained as navigation roots per FILTER-007 because auxiliary-channel delivery is unverified.
ITree/Effects/Empty.lean: read fully; defines `ITree.Effects.emptyE : Effect` with `I := PEmpty` in an exposed public section, a real declaration.
Test/ITree.lean: read fully; defines `f`, `spin2`, `test` via partial_fixpoint on ITree and an `example` proving `spin2 = spin2` by unfolding.
Test/ITreeEffect.lean: read fully; declares axioms E1 E2 E3 i2 and abbrevs t1 t2 over SumE effects plus a run_meta unification check.
Test/ITreeEval.lean: 10 declarations including ITree programs `add_1_plus_1`, `add_1_plus_1_fail`, `print` over failE/logE and a local MonadEval instance, with #guard_msgs evaluation checks.
Test/Stream.lean: 29 declarations; defines StreamF, a PF instance with proofs of unpack_pack/pack_unpack, Stream as CoInd, and simp theorems such as `snil_approx_1`.
HeapLang/Examples.lean: evalN evaluations of HeapLang programs with #guard_msgs, including looping, heap, and fork/data-race examples.

Declaration counts by grep: Coinductive/CoInd.lean 45, ITree/Definition.lean 51, ITree/Exec.lean 43, HeapLang/Notation.lean 39, HeapLang/Lang.lean 29, HeapLang/Semantics.lean 20, ITree/Effects/Conc.lean 20; every ITree/Effects/*.lean file has at least one declaration.
summary: Inspected all 28 changed files of the coinductive/ITree/HeapLang formal-semantics library. Every non-root file holds Lean declarations (defs, theorems, instances, inductives, axioms, examples). The four root/aggregator modules (Coinductive.lean, HeapLang.lean, ITree.lean, ITree/Effects.lean) are pure public-import modules, but FILTER-007 keeps them primary-eligible because no deployed auxiliary navigation channel was verified. All files stay searchable.
